rows: Does the most important content sit top and leading, with metadata and actions after it?
Does each separator sit where space alone cannot show the structure?
Does each static badge look different from the buttons beside it?
Do controls and text stay inside the layout margins?
Under dir=rtl, does the layout mirror cleanly? Only for apps that support RTL.
Is the screen simple and predictable?
props.title: Judge rules for layout

rows: Is all decorative text real text, not an image?
Do play, star and other asymmetric icons look centered?
Are icons outlined, with fill only on the active state?
Do avatars have an outline only when the controls beside them have borders?
Text-only. Does each alt text say what the image tells or does?
props.title: Judge rules for type, icons and images

rows: Does each status show an icon, text or underline as well as a color?
Does each semantic color keep its meaning?
Is each gradient free of hues nobody defined?
Over an image or a colored backdrop, does a card use a shadow instead of a border?
Does focus motion stay subtle during keyboard navigation?
Does each interaction use one subtle effect?
props.title: Judge rules for color and motion

rows: Text-only. Does each object and action keep one name?
Text-only. Does the tone match the stakes?
Text-only. Would a tired reader get each word on the first pass?
Text-only. Does progress copy use -ing plus object, and done copy use object plus past tense?
Do known requirements show as helper text before the input?
props.title: Judge rules for copy

rows: Does the build match its design at every frame width?
Is each value within 2px or one color step of the design?
Does user text survive emoji, RTL, mixed direction, tall scripts and aligned numbers?
props.title: Judge rules for design fidelity

text.insert: Six process rules have no check and stay with Ford or the agent that does the work.

rows: A control added to one surface is added to its siblings
A design build touches only what the frames show
Every candidate design clears the floor before anyone sees it
Every claimed value is tagged measured, derived or inferred
Use what you build end to end before you call it done
Add an element, animation or feature only when it clearly improves the result
props.title: Process rules
